title: Not as nice as presented. Seam came out on first washing
text:
Not as nice as presented. Seam came out on first washing. I thought with the thread count on this, the cases would be nicer. Not so much!

They feel like any other pillowcase. They fit my king size pillow just fine, but with the first washing, the edge opening seam came out!

I didn't save the packaging, thinking there shouldn't be any problems with a pillowcase with this alleged thread count.
So, I cannot return them or I would. Very disappointing, and the product just doesn't seem to match up with the claimed thread counts. I cannot recommend these.
